entities.name: Mehdi Qoli Khan Javanshir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehdi Qoli Khan Javanshir was the last Khan of the Karabakh Khanate, functioning as its head from 1806 to 1822. His only known issue was Khurshidbanu Natavan, a famous Azerbaijani poet.
